## Activity

Central Eye Clinic recorded 178 captures during November 2021. This activity provides the basis for review of image quality and grading performance for the reporting period. Capture activity should continue to be monitored through routine operational reporting, with any changes in volume considered alongside image quality and grading outcomes.

## Image quality

A total of 8 captures were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was recorded as 4.5. These cases should be reviewed through the usual quality assurance process to identify any common issues affecting image acquisition or assessment. The clinic lead has requested that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that they can be tracked and addressed through the appropriate support arrangements.

## Grading

There were 36 referable results during November 2021. The median grading lag was 9. This measure should continue to be monitored with referable outcomes to support timely review and ongoing service oversight. The activity, image quality and grading findings should be retained as part of the site’s routine operational record for Central Eye Clinic.
